title: Forms on your site that start customer journeys
summary: A test, a sign-up or a request on your own page. Every response goes straight into your CDP and can enroll the person in a customer journey within seconds.
body_markdown:
A test on your landing page, a webinar sign-up, a demo request. Today those responses usually end up in a form tool, and someone exports them, cleans them up and uploads them before anyone can write to each person. By then the interest has cooled.


You can now build **embedded forms** inside Boom. They live on your own page, every response goes straight into your[CDP](https://docs.useboom.ai/cdp/overview) , and every submission records an[event](https://docs.useboom.ai/events) your **[customer journeys](https://docs.useboom.ai/journeys)** can start on within seconds.


## How it works


In the left sidebar, open **Lead capture › Forms** and create a new form. From there:


- **Build the steps.** Each step groups questions: short or long answer, email, phone, number, one choice, several choices, dropdown, scale or text only.
- **Add a score if you want.** Scored answers add up, and the total picks the ending the person sees: a message, a button or a jump to the page you choose.
- **Publish and paste one tag.** The form is edited as a draft and reaches visitors when you publish it and set it Active. It only loads on the sites you allow.


## Make it look like your brand


Pick one of **8 looks** (colours, font and shape in one click) and adjust what you want on top: your colour, the font, the corners, a background image, or no background so it takes your page's. You can add a **welcome screen** before the first question. Visitors answer one question at a time, keyboard included.[See the design options](https://docs.useboom.ai/embedded-forms#make-it-look-like-yours) .


## Share it as a link


Want it in an ad, your bio or an email? Turn on the **hosted page** and your form lives at` useboom.ai/f/your-brand/your-form` , without touching your site.[How to share it](https://docs.useboom.ai/embedded-forms#share-a-link-instead) .


## In your language


Each form is written in one language, Spanish for example. Visitors see it in theirs when it is fully written in it, and otherwise in the form's own language, never mixed. You can also fix it so everyone sees the same one.[Languages](https://docs.useboom.ai/embedded-forms#languages) .


## What each response does


Each response creates or updates the person in **People** , with their email, their phone and the answers you choose to save on their profile. It also records an event named after your form, such as` test_estres_submitted` , with the result, the score and the visit's UTM tags.


With that event, a customer journey sends each person what fits their result: a WhatsApp with their result, an email with the webinar recording or a call for whoever asked for a demo. Your segments can filter by it too. **Hidden fields** add data from the page, such as a campaign or an ID from your own system.


Responses live in the form's **Responses** tab, with views, completion rate and **Export CSV** . Ones that look like spam are kept apart.


## Sensitive questions


Mark a question **Sensitive** when it is about health or something similar. That answer is stored encrypted, never travels on the event and is shown only to teammates with access to[sensitive data](https://docs.useboom.ai/hide-sensitive-data) . A form like that asks for consent to process the answers, with a link to your privacy notice, before it can be published.


## When someone asks you to stop


From a response you can **[Withdraw consent](https://docs.useboom.ai/embedded-forms#when-someone-asks-you-to-stop-or-to-delete-their-answers)** : the person goes on your Do Not Contact list, their WhatsApp and email opt-ins turn off, and their running journeys stop. **Erase** deletes all their responses and the events they created right away. Responses also delete themselves after the form's retention period, a year by default.


## From the API and MCP


You can also create, publish and read forms and their responses with the[REST API and MCP](https://docs.useboom.ai/use-mcp) , so a connected AI tool can build a form for you.


## Turn it on: ask Boom


Embedded forms are turned on per workspace. Write to us and we'll turn them on for your account.


There is no conditional logic between questions yet; the[documentation](https://docs.useboom.ai/embedded-forms) says what it covers today.
